name: network-axis-shell-blind-spot
title: A mode that denies the network cannot see the network its shell reaches
description: Measured in the twelve-session run: under code-development with sandbox.network none, npm install succeeded and fetched a new package version. The network axis matches eight tool names and the shell is not one of them, so the declaration covers tool-level network and not any network a bash or powershell command performs. The specification records the shell as a blind spot for file paths and says nothing about this axis. This task decides what the axis can honestly claim.
creator: aixi
